cancel_private_auction.description:
Seller while no bid is active, or anyone after `end_time + reclaim_grace`: NFT back
to the seller.

disclose_private_release.description:
Optional public disclosure: publish the release OVK (checked against `ovk_tag`)
so anyone can decrypt the payment notes and check them against `notes_cm`.

finalize_private_auction.description:
Settle to `bid_id`: `signature` by `finalize_vk` (all three parties) over the
shielded payment record, and `payment_ref` (zap-1 `app_data_hash`) naming a
Confirmed Zcash inclusion of the seller payment at the auction's payment client.
Moves the NFT to the bidder.

place_private_bid.description: Escrow note commitment + amount commitment (both hidden) + two FROST group keys.

reclaim_private_bid.description:
Close the bid and record its shielded refund. `signature` by `reclaim_vk` (bidder +
platform), or none from the bidder once the auction closed or the grace period passed.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

commitment.description: blake2b(COMMIT_DOMAIN || auction_id || bidder || escrow_cm || amount_zat || salt).

dkg_transcript.description:
Optional hash of the DKG transcript (identifier -> party map), bound in both
bind digests so all three parties attest the same share allocation.

escrow_cm.description: Note commitment of the shielded ZEC escrow note, spendable by `reclaim_vk`.

memo_cm.description:
`blake2b(memo_preimage(chain, contract, auction_id, bid_index))`, bid_index = the
bid id this bid will get. The contract recomputes it.

ovk_tag.description: `blake2b(OVK_DOMAIN || ovk)` of the bid's OVK; every release must use it.

sealed_bid.description:
Seller view envelope: `eph_pk || nonce || XChaCha20-Poly1305(ovk, amount, salt)`
to `seller_view_pk`, AAD `memo_cm` (see SPEC "seller view").

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_hex_binary_HexBinary
definitions.description:
This is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add hex de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is similar to `cosmwasm_std::Binary` but uses hex.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: svg_auction_private_ShieldedRelease
definitions.description: A Zcash payment authorised by a bid group, as recorded on Terp.

notes_cm.description:
`blake2b(NOTES_DOMAIN || n || note_1 || .. || note_n)` over the 382-byte
SEAM-NOTE-OUT encodings of the payment outputs (see [`notes_preimage`]). Each note
carries a random `rcm`, so the commitment hides values and destinations.

ovk_ciphertext.description: The same notes encrypted under the bid's OVK. Opaque on chain.

payment_cm.description:
Finalize only: note commitment of the seller's payment output, which the payment
client must attest as included on Zcash.
